item.text:
=== BEGIN ARTIFACT TOPOLOGY.md ===
## Declarations

## story architecture-foundation
summary:      Establish the Python application structure and boundary ownership.
type:         foundational
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   ARCHITECTURE.md
stack:        python.md
provides:     application modules, configuration boundary
accepts:       st-008
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Establish the Python application structure, module ownership, and configuration boundary described by ARCHITECTURE.md.

  Keep database-driver access inside the shipped persistence library. Resolve database configuration from DATABASE_URL, then DATABASE_PATH, then data/app.db.

## story database-foundation
summary:      Declare the rates store and generated persistence operations.
type:         foundational
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   DATABASE.md
context:      sources/INSTRUCTIONS.md
stack:        persistence.md, sqlite.md
depends:      architecture-foundation
provides:     rates repository operations
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Declare the rates table and every repository operation required by loading, statistics, effective-date rates, conversions, and history.

  Preserve rate values as text and use the generated persistence package for all database access.

## story api-foundation
summary:      Establish the FastAPI application and test client.
type:         foundational
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-API-Foundation.md
stack:        fastapi.md
depends:      architecture-foundation
provides:     app_server.main:create_app, app_server.testing:web_client
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Establish the FastAPI application factory, module-level app, and published TestClient helper. Provide the shared service foundation used by the API capability stories.

## story cli-foundation
summary:      Establish the fxrates command entry point.
type:         foundational
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-CLI-Foundation.md
stack:        cli.md
depends:      architecture-foundation
provides:     ./fxrates, cli.main, cli.testing:cli_runner
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Establish the executable and callable CLI entry point with the published in-process test helper. Provide the shared command foundation used by CLI capability stories.

## story ecb-init
summary:      Initialize an empty rates store from the command line.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-ECB-Init.md
covers:       ECB-001
context:      DATABASE.md, sources/INSTRUCTIONS.md
stack:        python.md, sqlite.md, cli.md
depends:      database-foundation, cli-foundation
provides:     fxrates init
consumes:     rates repository operations
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Implement fxrates init so it drops and recreates the rates table empty, using the configured store and the persistence boundary.

## story ecb-load
summary:      Validate and atomically load ECB CSV history.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-ECB-Load.md
covers:       ECB-002
accepts:       st-003
context:      DATABASE.md, sources/INSTRUCTIONS.md, sources/eurofxref-hist_2025-01.csv, sources/eurofxref-hist_bad.csv
stack:        python.md, sqlite.md, cli.md
depends:      database-foundation, cli-foundation
provides:     fxrates load
consumes:     rates repository operations
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Implement complete-file validation before writes. Ignore the trailing empty CSV field, skip N/A values, preserve published rate text, reject invalid or repeated dates and invalid values atomically, replace matching date/currency rates, and report date and rate counts.

## story ecb-fetch
summary:      Download and load ECB history from the published ZIP.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-ECB-Fetch.md
covers:       ECB-003
context:      DATABASE.md, sources/INSTRUCTIONS.md
stack:        python.md, sqlite.md, cli.md
depends:      ecb-load
provides:     fxrates fetch
consumes:     fxrates load
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Implement fetch by downloading the ECB history ZIP, extracting eurofxref-hist.csv, and applying the same validation, storage, and reporting rules as load.

  Tests must replace the download with a stub and make no network connection.

## story api-stats
summary:      Report stored publication statistics and currencies.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-API-Stats.md
covers:       ECB-004
context:      DATABASE.md, sources/INSTRUCTIONS.md
stack:        python.md, sqlite.md, fastapi.md
depends:      database-foundation, api-foundation
provides:     GET /stats, GET /currencies
consumes:     rates repository operations
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Implement the statistics and currencies JSON endpoints. Derive counts and date bounds from stored rates; return distinct stored currencies in ascending order.

## story api-health
summary:      Report service health.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-API-Health.md
covers:       API-001
accepts:       st-004
context:      sources/INSTRUCTIONS.md
stack:        python.md, fastapi.md
depends:      api-foundation
provides:     GET /health
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Implement GET /health with the specified JSON health response.

## story api-rates
summary:      Retrieve rates for an effective or latest publication date.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-API-Rates.md
covers:       API-002, API-003
accepts:       st-005
context:      DATABASE.md, sources/INSTRUCTIONS.md
stack:        python.md, sqlite.md, fastapi.md
depends:      database-foundation, api-foundation, ecb-load
provides:     GET /rates/{date}, GET /rates/latest
consumes:     rates repository operations
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Implement date-based and latest-rate endpoints. Resolve requests to the latest publication on or before the requested date, return all stored rates for that publication, and return 404 when no publication exists.

## story api-convert
summary:      Convert amounts between currencies using exact decimal arithmetic.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-API-Convert.md
covers:       API-004
accepts:       st-005, st-006
context:      DATABASE.md, sources/INSTRUCTIONS.md
stack:        python.md, sqlite.md, fastapi.md
depends:      database-foundation, api-foundation, ecb-load
provides:     GET /convert
consumes:     rates repository operations
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Implement conversion with the effective publication date, EUR's implicit rate, exact Decimal arithmetic, half-even rounding, and the specified six-decimal rate and two-decimal result strings. Compute the result from unrounded stored rates.

## story api-history
summary:      Retrieve currency history and exact summary statistics.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-API-History.md
covers:       API-005
accepts:       st-006
context:      DATABASE.md, sources/INSTRUCTIONS.md
stack:        python.md, sqlite.md, fastapi.md
depends:      database-foundation, api-foundation, ecb-load
provides:     GET /history/{code}
consumes:     rates repository operations
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Implement inclusive optional date bounds, ascending points, exact Decimal extrema and half-even six-decimal mean, plus the specified empty-range response. Return 404 for a currency with no stored rate.

## story api-validation
summary:      Return the specified errors for invalid API requests.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-API-Validation.md
covers:       API-006
accepts:       st-007
context:      sources/INSTRUCTIONS.md
stack:        python.md, fastapi.md
depends:      api-foundation, api-rates, api-convert, api-history
provides:     API request validation behavior
consumes:     GET /rates/{date}, GET /convert, GET /history/{code}
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Ensure malformed dates and amounts and missing required query parameters return 422. Ensure unknown or unavailable currencies return 404 on the applicable routes.

## story cli-serve
summary:      Serve the local JSON API with the command line.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-CLI-Serve.md
covers:       CLI-001
accepts:       st-004
context:      sources/INSTRUCTIONS.md
stack:        python.md, fastapi.md, cli.md
depends:      api-foundation, cli-foundation, api-health
provides:     fxrates serve
consumes:     app_server.main:app
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Implement foreground serving on 127.0.0.1 with the requested port or default 8000. Ensure the process stops cleanly on SIGTERM.

## story cli-errors
summary:      Report CLI usage and operational failures.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-CLI-Errors.md
covers:       CLI-002
context:      sources/INSTRUCTIONS.md
stack:        python.md, cli.md
depends:      cli-foundation, ecb-init, ecb-load, ecb-fetch, cli-serve
provides:     CLI exit codes and diagnostics
consumes:     fxrates init, fxrates load, fxrates fetch, fxrates serve
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Implement the specified exit codes for success, operational failures, usage errors, and rejected files. A failing command writes no stdout and one diagnostic line to stderr.

## story verification-suite
summary:      Provide the project pytest suite and POSIX test runner.
type:         service
kind:         test harness
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-Verification-Suite.md
covers:       VERIFY-001
accepts:       st-002, st-009
context:      sources/INSTRUCTIONS.md
stack:        python.md
depends:      architecture-foundation, database-foundation, api-foundation, cli-foundation, ecb-init, ecb-load, ecb-fetch, ecb-stats, api-health, api-rates, api-convert, api-history, api-validation, cli-serve, cli-errors
provides:     bin/test.sh, pytest suite
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Provide a POSIX-compatible bin/test.sh and a pytest suite covering the commands, loading rules, endpoints, effective-date behavior, rounding, and error statuses against a real temporary database. Stub fetch downloads so tests never use the network.

## story release-verification
summary:      Pass the supplied end-to-end grader.
type:         service
kind:         test harness
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-Release-Verification.md
covers:       VERIFY-002
accepts:       st-001
context:      sources/run.sh, sources/eurofxref-hist_2025-01.csv, sources/eurofxref-hist_2025-02-03_04.csv, sources/eurofxref-hist_bad.csv
context_roles: |
  sources/run.sh: context
  sources/eurofxref-hist_2025-01.csv: asset
  sources/eurofxref-hist_2025-02-03_04.csv: asset
  sources/eurofxref-hist_bad.csv: asset
stack:        python.md, common.md
depends:      architecture-foundation, database-foundation, api-foundation, cli-foundation, ecb-init, ecb-load, ecb-fetch, api-stats, api-health, api-rates, api-convert, api-history, api-validation, cli-serve, cli-errors, verification-suite
provides:     full supplied grader acceptance
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  As the terminal story, run the complete supplied grader using its documented invocation and require exit status zero. Do not modify or substitute any staged source asset.
=== END ARTIFACT ===
